entries.label: Equinox Dreams
cells: Unlocks a Dream cloud through which you can complete challenges. More clouds allows you to see more challenges at once

entries.label: Equinox Resources
cells: Unlocks a new resource to gather right here in the equinox. Each one has it's own Vial in Alchemy, but no card

entries.label: Equinox Symbols
cells: +1 all talent LVs, as long as they have a single point invested

entries.label: Faux Jewels
cells: +5% Drop Rate. This is additive, so it's great but not THAT great. DR is DR though right?

entries.label: Food Lust
cells: Defeating a Random Event boss lowers Meal upgrade cost by -20%. Stacks up to 1 times. Resets when meal is upgraded. (For the number ppl out there, this is 0.80x cost per stack)

entries.label: Laboratory Fuse
cells: +1 px longer connection range for all Lab bonuses and jewels, unless they state otherwise

entries.label: Liquidvestment
cells: If liquid is full, 9% of excess liquid generated will be invested into CAP/RATE upgrades.

entries.label: Matching Scims
cells: +10% Damage. This is its own multiplier, so it's EXTRA powerful!

entries.label: Metal Detector
cells: +1% nugget size for each nugget you dig up that isn't a new biggest nug. Once you do eventually dig up a new best, this bonus resets.

entries.label: Nonstop Studies
cells: +3% Research EXP. This is its own multiplier, so it's EXTRA powerful!

entries.label: Shades of K
cells: Adds another choice at the end of each Killroy Run to invest into

entries.label: Slow Roast Wiz
cells: +1% tower dmg every second for all towers in worship, resets when a new wave starts. Only starts working after 10 seconds

entries.label: Voter Rights
cells: +1% higher Ballot Bonus from the voter slime in World 2 town!

pageProps.seoDescription: Every one of the 13 equinox upgrades in Legends of Idleon, and what each one connects to.
